**The moment**

**What you do today instead**

**Does it stay inside the project?**

Mac only. Swift stays. The take stays in memory, and nothing is saved to disk. No one's background is hardcoded. Zoom will not list a camera named Presence until Apple has signed the app.

If this request crosses one of those, say which. The full list is in CONTRIBUTING.md. A cross needs an explicit yes before any code.

**Are you offering to build it?**

- [ ] I am asking. Someone else can build it.
- [ ] I want to build it, after I hear yes.

A yes welcomes a pull request from your fork. It is not a release date. Opening this issue does not grant write access.

Do not attach a recording or a screenshot of a real meeting.
